tweets.text:
Cool insights from @JasonYanowitz over at Blockworks: 

Institutional customer optimism is in up only mode.

What's behind us is a massive flush out of the opportunistic and extractive crowd, along with a painful realization, delivered through years of underwhelming price action, of just how much work it takes to grow into our valuations.

Right now, we're at the bottom.

What's ahead of us is smart money accumulating, institutions and TradFi adopting our technology, and the most talented, committed founders finally shipping all the progress and news they've been sitting on for years. The result will be a massively reflexive cascade of liquidity, users and attention for years.

Every new technology goes through these cycles, including a brutal stretch of trying to cross the chasm and survive long enough to be proven for mass adoption.

We might not be in the age of cypherpunks, innovators and early adopters anymore. But being right just ahead of the mainstream is often the best risk reward there is.

So congrats if you're reading this. Because whatever the sentiment out there is, I'm still strongly convinced there has hardly ever been a better time to be here than right now.

The golden age is right ahead of us.
